workload.name: CPU daily
workload.description: PassMark PerformanceTest CPU tests, the hardware suite's passmark group only, every day on each provider's 2 vCPU runners and on the few runners at other sizes whose label continues a line of runs-on.com's CPU history. The figure it is for is PassMark 'CPU Single Threaded' (metrics.cpu.passmarkSingle): the test and settings of the hardware suite, so a runner's daily points and its hardware-suite points are one series.
workload.passmark: PassMark PerformanceTest Linux V11 (latest V11 build from passmark.com), pt_linux -r 1 -i 2 -p <vCPUs> -d 2

runners.note: Linux on Apple Silicon (early access; Apple M4 Pro or M5 Max hosts), billed at 7x the Linux rate: $0.084/min at 4x16 (overage rate). The -with-features suffix keeps plain nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-arm64-4x16 jobs off these runners.
